forbidden.name: domain-no-ui-or-outer-layers
forbidden.comment: El dominio no debe importar React, Next.js, adaptadores, composition, infrastructure ni presentation.

forbidden.name: domain-no-node-modules-ui
forbidden.comment: Dominio sin dependencias de paquetes UI/framework.

forbidden.name: application-no-adapters-or-next
forbidden.comment: Application depende de puertos/contratos; no de adaptadores concretos ni de Next.js.

forbidden.name: ports-no-adapters
forbidden.comment: Los puertos son contratos; no importan adaptadores ni composition.

forbidden.name: no-direct-database-from-ui
forbidden.comment: Presentación / App Router no acceden a BD ni SDK de persistencia (Supabase client, prisma, etc.).

forbidden.name: presentation-prefer-ports-over-adapters
forbidden.comment: UI/App Router no deben acoplarse a adaptadores HTTP concretos; usar composition/ports. Severidad error: hallazgo real si existe (no se excluye).

forbidden.name: no-circular
forbidden.comment: Dependencias circulares entre módulos del frontend.
